name: Western US MTBS-Interagency (WUMI) wildfire dataset
model_or_instrument: MTBS, CalFire, US FWS, US FS, BIA, BLM, BOR, NPS
size_as_stated: 18 646 fire locations and burned areas from 1984 to 2020

scales.note: WUMI wildfire dataset of 18,646 fire events across the western US (west of 103W) from 1984 to 2020, aggregated to 12 km grid cells at monthly and annual scales.
